title: Lightning Events Detected from the ISS, 2017–2023
description: Lightning detected by the Lightning Imaging Sensor on the International Space Station, shown with a rolling 10-day window on a flat global map (Science On a Sphere format).
highlights: Seasonal shifts north and south move the melody
A global map: drapes onto the globe
